statement: CoreWeave raised full-year 2026 capital-expenditure guidance to $35 billion to $39 billion, after spending $9.4 billion of capex in a single quarter.
why: A raised capex plan from a large GPU buyer points to more accelerator and data-center orders ahead; the document reports a range rather than a single figure, so no point value is recorded.

impact.mechanism: Higher committed capital spending by a neocloud translates into incremental GPU, networking and colocation purchase orders.

evidence.excerpt: full-year 2026 guidance was raised to $35 billion to $39 billion

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet only; guidance range restated without a linked company filing.
